product_overview: VetSoftwarePublicFront is the employee-facing web app for a veterinary clinic, used to handle patient intake, clinical consultations, medical history, operations, sales, billing, and staff administration. It supports multi-tenant clinic data with role-based access control and Spanish-language workflows.
core_goals: Sign in to the clinic workspace and access authorized operational areas
Register and manage owners and pets as part of clinical intake
Create consultations and attach clinical procedures such as prescriptions, lab tests, imaging, vaccinations, hospitalization, surgery, and spa services
Browse a pet’s unified clinical history across visits and procedures
Manage hospitalization care, including medication schedules and dose tracking
Operate the store/POS to sell products and services and generate electronic sales documents
Handle open accounts, charges, payments, and account closure for customers
Configure and use electronic billing documents and reporting for DIAN compliance
Manage employees, assign roles, and adjust permissions within the clinic

features.name: Employee Login
features.description: Allows an employee to authenticate with their employee code and password, start a session, and enter the clinic workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in employee code -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to / -> Fill in employee code -> Fill in password incorrectly -> Submit the login form -> See a validation or credential error message

features.name: Session Guard and Authorization
features.description: Keeps protected clinic areas available only to authenticated users and only when they have the required permission for a route.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard without a session -> Get redirected to / -> See the login page
Sign in successfully -> Navigate to a protected area allowed by the user’s permissions -> See the requested workspace
Sign in successfully -> Navigate to a protected area without the required permission -> Get redirected to the dashboard home

features.name: Registration
features.description: Lets a clinic create a new company account and its first employee administrator through the self-service signup flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill in the company and employee registration details -> Complete the geographic selections -> Submit the registration form -> See the new account created
Navigate to /signup -> Fill in invalid or incomplete registration data -> Attempt to continue -> See field validation messages and remain on the signup flow

features.name: New Consultation Wizard
features.description: Guides an authorized user through creating a clinical consultation, including owner and pet selection or creation, consultation details, quick clinical actions, and saving the record.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/consulta/nueva -> Search for an owner or create a new one -> Select or create a pet -> Continue to the consultation step -> Fill in consultation type and anamnesis -> Add clinical actions such as prescriptions or lab tests -> Review the summary -> Save the consultation -> See the success screen
Navigate to /dashboard/consulta/nueva -> Leave required owner, pet, or consultation fields empty -> Try to continue or save -> See validation messages and stay on the current step
Navigate to /dashboard/consulta/nueva -> Start filling a consultation draft -> Leave the page -> Return later to the wizard -> See the saved draft restored

features.name: Clinical History Browser
features.description: Lets a user drill down from owner to pet and review the animal’s unified clinical history timeline.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/consulta/historial -> Search and select an owner -> Select one of the owner’s pets -> View the pet’s clinical history timeline
Navigate to /dashboard/consulta/historial -> Search for an owner -> Open the owner’s pet list -> Select a pet -> View the pet’s consultation and record history

features.name: Standalone Clinical Actions
features.description: Provides independent flows to register procedures such as laboratory tests, diagnostic imaging, vaccinations, hospitalization, deworming, surgery, and spa without starting from a consultation.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/acciones/laboratorio -> Select a pet -> Fill in the laboratory test details -> Submit the procedure -> See it created
Navigate to /dashboard/acciones/imagen -> Select a pet -> Fill in the imaging details -> Submit the procedure -> See it created
Navigate to /dashboard/acciones/vacunacion -> Select a pet -> Fill in the vaccination details -> Submit the procedure -> See it created
Navigate to /dashboard/acciones/hospitalizacion -> Select a pet -> Fill in the hospitalization details -> Submit the procedure -> See it created
Navigate to /dashboard/acciones/desparasitacion -> Select a pet -> Fill in the deworming details -> Submit the procedure -> See it created
Navigate to /dashboard/acciones/cirugia -> Select a pet -> Fill in the surgery details -> Submit the procedure -> See it created
Navigate to /dashboard/acciones/spa -> Select a pet -> Fill in the spa service details -> Submit the procedure -> See it created

features.name: Hospitalization Ward and Medication Administration
features.description: Supports viewing hospitalized pets, generating medication schedules, applying doses, reprogramming doses, and discharging a hospitalization.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/hospital -> Review the list of hospitalized pets -> Open a hospitalization -> View its medication schedule
Navigate to /dashboard/hospital -> Open a scheduled dose -> Confirm the dose application -> See the dose marked as applied
Navigate to /dashboard/hospital -> Open a scheduled dose -> Choose a new time for the dose -> Reprogram it -> See the schedule updated
Navigate to /dashboard/hospital -> Open a hospitalization record -> End the stay with discharge details -> See the hospitalization closed

features.name: Laboratory Workbench
features.description: Allows authorized users to search laboratory tests and review or attach associated result files.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/laboratorio -> Search for a laboratory test -> Open the test -> View or attach result files

features.name: Store / Point of Sale
features.description: Lets users search and add products to a sale, manage store catalogs, and emit an electronic document from the completed sale.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/tienda -> Search for products -> Add products to the sale -> Review the cart -> Complete the sale -> See the electronic document generated
Navigate to /dashboard/tienda/inventario -> Review or update the product inventory catalog -> Save the changes -> Return to the store workflow
Navigate to /dashboard/tienda/servicios -> Review or update the services catalog -> Save the changes -> Return to the store workflow
Navigate to /dashboard/tienda/promociones -> Review or update promotions -> Save the changes -> Return to the store workflow
Navigate to /dashboard/tienda/impuestos -> Review or update taxes -> Save the changes -> Return to the store workflow

features.name: Open Accounts
features.description: Manages customer open accounts, including searching accounts, adding product or service charges, reviewing balances, and closing accounts through payment or cancellation.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/cuentas -> Search for a customer account -> Open the account -> Add product or service charges -> Review the account balance
Navigate to /dashboard/cuentas -> Search for a customer account -> Add charges to an open account -> Confirm the changes -> See the updated balance
Navigate to /dashboard/cuentas -> Open an account with a zero balance -> Close the account -> See the account marked as closed
Navigate to /dashboard/cuentas -> Attempt to open a second open account for the same owner -> See an account conflict message
Navigate to /dashboard/cuentas -> Attempt to close an account with a nonzero balance -> See a state validation message

features.name: Electronic Billing (DIAN)
features.description: Provides electronic document emission, fiscal setup, and sales/report viewing for the clinic’s DIAN billing flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/facturacion/documentos -> Review electronic documents -> Emit a new electronic document -> See the document created
Navigate to /dashboard/facturacion/habilitacion -> Review the company tax profile and numbering resolutions -> Complete the setup review flow -> See billing readiness status
Navigate to /dashboard/facturacion/reportes -> Review the sales book and reconciliation reports -> Inspect the reported sales data

features.name: Employees and Roles Administration
features.description: Enables clinic staff management, role assignment, and permission configuration by module and sub-module.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/empleados -> Review the employee list -> Create a new employee -> Assign a role -> Save the employee
Navigate to /dashboard/empleados -> Open an existing employee -> Edit the employee details -> Save the changes -> See the updated record
Navigate to /dashboard/roles -> Review the available roles -> Open a role -> Adjust its permissions -> Save the role configuration -> See the updated permissions

routes.description: Employee login page (guest only). Uses LoginForm with employee code + password.
Authenticated dashboard home inside AppLayout shell.
Clinical history browser (owner -> pet -> history steps).
List of pets for a selected owner in clinical history.
Full clinical history detail for a specific pet.
Electronic billing reports / sales book (permission ELECTRONIC_BILLING_CREATE).
DIAN enablement / company tax profile setup (permission ELECTRONIC_BILLING_CREATE).

features.name: Employee Login
features.description: Authenticate with employee code and password; stores JWT session and hydrates permissions.
user_interactions: Fill employee code field
Fill password field
Click the login/submit button
See validation or credential error message on failure
On success, get redirected to /dashboard

features.name: Session guard and authorization

user_interactions: Attempt to open a protected route without a session and get redirected to login
Attempt to open a route without the required permission and get redirected to home
See a session-expired toast when the access token is expired without refresh token

user_interactions: Complete owner step (name, document, phone) and continue
Complete pet step (name, species, breed, gender, weight) and continue
Fill consultation type and anamnesis, add quick actions (prescriptions, lab tests, imaging, vaccination, etc.)
Review summary and click Save consultation
See partial-save banner and retry when a POST fails mid-cascade

features.name: Clinical History Browser
features.description: Drill down from owner to pet to full clinical history.
user_interactions: Search and select an owner
Select a pet from the owner's pets
View the pet's consultations and clinical records timeline

features.name: Store / Point of Sale
features.description: POS plus catalogs for inventory (products), services, promotions and taxes; can emit an electronic document from a sale.
user_interactions: Search products and add them to a sale
Manage inventory, services, promotions and taxes
Emit an electronic document from a completed sale

features.name: Open Accounts
features.description: Manage customer open accounts and their product/service/general/debt charges.
user_interactions: Search and open a customer account
Add product, service, general or debt charges
Review the account balance

features.name: Electronic Billing (DIAN)
features.description: Emit and manage electronic documents, configure numbering resolutions and company tax profile (DIAN enablement), and view sales reports.
user_interactions: Emit an electronic document
Configure numbering resolutions and company tax profile
View sales book and reconciliation reports

features.name: Employees and Roles Administration
features.description: Manage employees and configure roles/permissions per company.

Assign roles to employees
Configure role permissions by module/sub-module

features.name: Laboratory Workbench
features.description: List, search and attach files to laboratory tests.
user_interactions: Search laboratory tests
Open a test and view/attach result files

known_limitations.issue: No cross-endpoint rollback in the New Consultation save cascade; a lost response after a successful POST /consultations can duplicate the consultation on retry (no server idempotency key).
known_limitations.impact: Rare duplicate consultations under transport failures; client-side retry skips already-saved items but cannot dedupe a server-side duplicate.

known_limitations.issue: Backend gaps documented for the store module (no dedicated Venta/POS sale entity nor product bundles).
known_limitations.impact: Some POS/store flows are partially UI-driven or rely on workarounds rather than a full backend sale model.

known_limitations.issue: Weight and size values are rounded to integers in the animal mapper.
known_limitations.impact: Decimal precision for weight (kg) is lost on persistence.
